definition.def: If you cycle, you ride a bicycle.
examples: Britain could save £4.6 billion a year in road transport costs if more people cycled. [VERB]
Over 1000 riders cycled 100 miles around the Vale of York. [VERB noun]

definition.def: A cycle is a series of events or processes that is repeated again and again, always in the same order.
examples: ...the life cycle of the plant. [+ of]
The figures marked the final low point of the present economic cycle.
They must break out of the cycle of violence.

definition.def: A cycle is a single complete series of movements in an electrical, electronic, or mechanical process.
A cycle is a series of songs or poems that are intended to be performed or read one after the other.
